notes.title: Patch Note 0.7.9.8 - Clearing the old tasks
notes.content:
Hi everyone,


It seems like a little update but I think you'll feel the difference :D

[h1][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Super spikes won't soft block
[*] Long tips are faster
[*] Middle tips are slower
[*] the block will almost all the time touch the ball if the timing is right
[*] Increase variation of the toss (for serves)
[*] AI reaction time increased to make it "more human"
[*] AI should be a bit stronger against long serves/setter dumps
[*] AI won't dive if there is the middle blocker is doing his job
[*] AI will be able to see if his hitter can attack above the opponent blocker
[/list]

[h1][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] When the player fail a overhand receives/defenses, the animation doesn't stop directly
[*] Team names center in match results
[*] Pink Black court is really pink (it was red)
[*] Change lighting a bit to avoid sunny ball
[*] You can press Escap with any device to pause the game
[*] When you change a video setting, it applies directly
[/list]

[h1][b]BUGS FIXED[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Characteristics for jump were assigned to wrong players sometimes
[*] Impact of setter characteristic (DEX) wasn't applied sometimes
[*] Press Escap in the settings during a match was doing bad stuff
[*] Statistics being negatives
[/list]


Have a nice day ♥
Joé

notes.title: Patch Note 0.7.4.6 - Change defense / receive system
notes.content:
Hi everyone,


Little update to change the defense/receive system.

[h1][b]NEW SYSTEM[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Long balls : instead of having to hold BACKWARD and press A, you just have to press BACKWARD
[*] Middle balls : no change (you press A to bump)
[*] Short balls : instead of having to hold FORWARD and press A, you just have to press FORWARD
[/list]

I know some of you could prefer the old system but it makes things way easier in the long run with this new system especially for fast plays where having to press A was a mess.
It will also avoid the "oh I pressed A before the arrow..." moments.


Have a nice day ♥
Joé

[*] Short balls : instead of having to hold FORWARD and press A, you just have to press FORWARD

You know this feeling when the guy in front of you is WAY TOO TALL and keeps blocking you ? Hinata does.
We didn't like it so we added the possibility to imitate our icon : THE LITTLE GIANT !
You can now hit hard high hands and if the guy try to block you, it will results as a block out :D
But be carefull with this technique because without the block, your ball will go out xD

[h3][b]SlowMotion[/b][/h3]

notes.title: Devlog #3 New system
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

Long time no see, right ? :3

[b]NEW SYSTEM ![/b]
It was for a good reason ! We were working on our full new game system. For your eyes, you can't probably see the difference but for us, it changes everything !
Indeed, we can now add / modify moves (sets, spikes, defenses) without having to change the full game.

[b]New teams[/b]
We had new teams :
- Cuba
- Canada
- Italia
- Iran
- Netherlands
- Tunisia
- Serbia
- Slovenia

[b]New courts[/b]
We had new courts to have various environnements  (for the moment, it's colors skins only)
